pythonFunction.name: update_ebill_preference
pythonFunction.description:
Turns paperless eBill on or off for the account. Needs an authenticated caller. Before calling
this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    account_id: Account id of the authenticated account (REQUIRED).
    enrolled: True to turn eBill on, false to turn it off (REQUIRED).
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok and ebil_flag.
